newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies end narrowly mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies end narrowly mixed in thin trade.

text.p: Oct 1 - IMM currency futures ended narrowly mixed in thin, lackluster trade. Most currencies consolidated from Monday's sharp declines, and remained below highs set on GLOBEX. Can dollars, however, continued to firm, with Dec rallying through resistance at $0.7372, traders said. -Derivatives Desk/(312) 408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
